author: Blog Staff
description:
The Standard C++ Foundation is pleased to welcome Hudson River Trading (HRT) as our newest Gold Sponsor!

HRT is a global quantitative trading firm that combines advanced mathematics, technology, and high-performance software - including C++ - to develop sophisticated automated trading systems.

The Foundation works to support the development, adoption, and ongoing evolution of the C++ programming language. Our sponsors play an important role in making this work possible and strengthening the global C++ community.

We appreciate HRT's commitment to the future of C++ and are grateful for their support.

Thank you, Hudson River Trading, for joining us!

title: Welcome Hudson River Trading as a Gold Sponsor of the Standard C++ Foundation

author: Blog Staff
description:
C++26 introduces std::inplace_vector, a new container that combines the flexibility of std::vector with fixed-capacity, inline storage that requires no dynamic allocation. This article explores its API, overflow-handling options, performance considerations, and how it compares with existing standard library containers.

C++26: std::inplace_vector

by Sandor Dargo

From the article:

C++26 is generous with new containers — we’re getting both std::hive and std::inplace_vector. In this post, we’ll look at the latter.

author: Meeting C++
description:
You still can join next weeks Meeting C++ conference by getting a ticket for online or onsite!

Meeting C++ 2026 is next week

by Jens Weller

From the page:

This years Meeting C++ is a hybrid event in Berlin and online on 26th - 28th November 2026.

The conference will be again hybrid - just like last year, attendees will join us on location in Berlin, but the conference will be also featuring online and onsite only content.
title: Meeting C++ 2026 is next week!
